tasks.corrected_reference_answer: Oracle get_sequences first queries identity primary-key metadata and returns its sequence name; without a row it returns table/column information for an AutoField from table_fields, for backward compatibility (django/db/backends/oracle/introspection.py:219-253). PostgreSQL queries sequence dependencies on table columns (django/db/backends/postgresql/introspection.py:129-153). Neither is a general manual-versus-automatic creation detector; PostgreSQL checks linkage rather than provenance.

tasks.corrected_reference_answer: OperationCategory combines string-compatible values with named enum members (django/db/migrations/operations/base.py:7-13). Members compare as their underlying strings while retaining enum identity. The actual migration display path explicitly reads category.value, or MIXED.value, to prefix describe() (112-117). This supports consistent symbolic labels; it does not imply that arbitrary string formatting or serializers treat a str/Enum member exactly like its raw value.

tasks.corrected_reference_answer: Field.deconstruct loops over a fixed set of possible attributes and normalizes its import path (django/db/models/fields/__init__.py:636-664). MigrationAutodetector.deep_deconstruct recursively processes returned arguments for comparisons (django/db/migrations/autodetector.py:74-110), and serialization sorts and serializes kwargs (django/db/migrations/serializer.py:98-119). More fields and nested arguments therefore entail more work, but these sources do not establish a measured bottleneck or a universal O(n*m) runtime.

tasks.notes: Read the question/reference and relevant pinned-source code; static review only, no repository code executed.
tasks.corrected_reference_answer: test_named overrides LOGIN_REDIRECT_URL to password_reset and expects /password_reset/ after login (tests/auth_tests/test_views.py:1024-1040). It needs a URLconf with that name; reverse obtains a resolver, and get_resolver falls back to settings.ROOT_URLCONF when no URLconf override exists (django/urls/base.py:38-40; django/urls/resolvers.py:108-111). No preceding test or HTTP request is needed to initialize reverse. resolve_url retries literal URLs only under its fallback rules and reraises for unresolved bare names (django/shortcuts.py:182-191).

tasks.corrected_reference_answer: silly_tribble is a non-null ForeignKey to migrations.Tribble with CASCADE (tests/migrations/migrations_test_apps/unmigrated_app/models.py:4-7). Collector discovers reverse relations and either schedules eligible related querysets for fast deletion or invokes CASCADE, which recursively collects dependents (django/db/models/deletion.py:22-31,309-363). Non-null relationships record deletion dependencies (116-145); sort orders dependencies first (413-439). Related SillyModel rows are removed before the referenced Tribble, within the deletion transaction, not afterward.

tasks.corrected_reference_answer: ValidationError.messages reuses __iter__ to present consistent formatted messages: list(self) for list errors and sum(dict(self).values(), []) for field dictionaries (django/core/exceptions.py:192-215). __iter__ applies parameters and converts messages to strings. This centralizes formatting logic, but the dictionary case still constructs intermediate lists/dictionary and concatenates lists; it does not guarantee minimal traversal or copying.
